correctness.rationale: For N=V⊕(V⊗V) with W=N², Leibniz forces every derivation D(v,w)=(Av,f(v)+(A⊗I+I⊗A)w). D²=D is equivalent to A²=A, B²=B, Bf+fA=f. Splitting V=im A ⊕ ker A gives B scalar sectors 2,1,1,0, so char!=2 forces D=0; in char2 allowed f blocks are exactly UU⊕ZZ from U and UZ⊕ZU from Z. Rank is r+2r(n-r), Gaussian subspace/complement count yields the claimed q-polynomial, and the half-rank bound follows from (n-2r)(n-2r+1)/2. Independent exact GF(2) n=2 full enumeration gives 1+256T²+96T³=353, using rank over GF(2), not real rank.
